declare v_ngo public.ngo_profiles%rowtype;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'UNAUTHENTICATED'; end if;
  select * into v_ngo from public.ngo_profiles
   where user_id=auth.uid() and active_flag;
  if not found or v_ngo.location_verified_at is null then return; end if;
  return query
  select l.listing_id,l.source_type,
    case when l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' then d.title else 'Community Hub Batch' end,
    l.listing_weight_kg,l.created_at,
    case when l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' then d.collection_path else 'HUB_COLLECTION' end,
    public.geolock_road_eligible_km(v_ngo.user_id,l.listing_id)*1000,
    'READY'::text,
    case
      when l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
        and public.can_read_geolock_donation_image(di.storage_path) then di.storage_path
      when l.source_type='HUB_BATCH'
        and public.can_read_geolock_batch_image(bi.storage_path) then bi.storage_path
      when l.source_type='HUB_BATCH'
        and public.can_read_geolock_donation_image(member_img.storage_path) then member_img.storage_path
      else null
    end,
    l.batch_id,l.donation_id
  from public.listings l
  join public.coordination_config cfg on cfg.singleton
  left join public.donations d on d.donation_id=l.donation_id
  left join public.hub_batches b on b.batch_id=l.batch_id
  left join lateral(select i.storage_path from public.donation_images i
    where i.donation_id=d.donation_id and i.display_order=1 limit 1) di on true
  left join lateral(select i.storage_path from public.hub_batch_images i
    where i.batch_id=b.batch_id and i.is_primary limit 1) bi on true
  left join lateral(select i.storage_path from public.hub_batch_members m
    join public.donation_images i on i.donation_id=m.donation_id and i.display_order=1
    join public.donations md on md.donation_id=m.donation_id
    where m.batch_id=b.batch_id and m.membership_status='ACTIVE'
    order by md.created_at,md.donation_id limit 1) member_img on true
  where l.listing_status='AVAILABLE'
    and (l.listing_expires_at is null or l.listing_expires_at>clock_timestamp())
    and public.geolock_road_eligible_km(v_ngo.user_id,l.listing_id) is not null
    and ((l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' and d.donation_status='AVAILABLE')
      or (l.source_type='HUB_BATCH' and b.batch_status='PUBLISHED'))
  order by l.created_at desc;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geolock_storage_can_upload_batch_image(p_bucket text, p_name text, p_metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid:=auth.uid();
  v_ext text:=lower(split_part(coalesce(p_name,''),'.',array_length(string_to_array(coalesce(p_name,''),'.'),1)));
  v_type text:=p_metadata->>'mimetype';
begin
  if v_actor is null or p_bucket<>'geolock-donation-images'
     or coalesce(v_type,'') not in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')
     or not exists(select 1 from storage.buckets b where b.id=p_bucket and not b.public
       and b.file_size_limit=5242880
       and b.allowed_mime_types=array['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp']::text[])
     or (v_ext in ('jpg','jpeg') and v_type<>'image/jpeg')
     or (v_ext='png' and v_type<>'image/png')
     or (v_ext='webp' and v_type<>'image/webp')
     or v_ext not in ('jpg','jpeg','png','webp')
     or p_name !~ ('^'||v_actor::text||'/batches/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}[.](jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$') then
    return false;
  end if;
  return exists(select 1 from public.hub_batches b
    join public.community_hubs h using(hub_id)
    where b.batch_id::text=split_part(p_name,'/',3) and h.admin_user_id=v_actor)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.hub_batch_images i
      where i.batch_id::text=split_part(p_name,'/',3));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geolock_storage_can_upload_donation_image(p_bucket text, p_name text, p_metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid:=auth.uid();
  v_ext text:=lower(split_part(coalesce(p_name,''),'.',array_length(string_to_array(coalesce(p_name,''),'.'),1)));
  v_type text:=p_metadata->>'mimetype';
begin
  if v_actor is null or p_bucket<>'geolock-donation-images'
     or coalesce(v_type,'') not in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')
     or not exists(select 1 from storage.buckets b where b.id=p_bucket and not b.public
       and b.file_size_limit=5242880
       and b.allowed_mime_types=array['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp']::text[])
     or (v_ext in ('jpg','jpeg') and v_type<>'image/jpeg')
     or (v_ext='png' and v_type<>'image/png')
     or (v_ext='webp' and v_type<>'image/webp')
     or v_ext not in ('jpg','jpeg','png','webp')
     or not exists(select 1 from public.donor_profiles dp where dp.user_id=v_actor) then
    return false;
  end if;
  -- Storage's pre-insert RLS probe supplies mimetype and contentLength; it does
  -- not reliably supply the final size key yet. The private bucket enforces the
  -- 5 MB transfer limit, and the create RPC checks stored metadata.size before
  -- attaching the object.
  if p_name ~ ('^'||v_actor::text||'/pending/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}[.](jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$') then
    return true;
  end if;
  -- Legacy path remains supported for an existing donor-owned donation.
  if p_name ~ ('^'||v_actor::text||'/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}[.](jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$') then
    return exists(select 1 from public.donations d
      where d.donation_id::text=split_part(p_name,'/',2) and d.donor_user_id=v_actor);
  end if;
  return false;
end;
$function$

      or exists(select 1 from public.claim_requests q where q.ngo_user_id=v_user and q.listing_id=p_entity_id)
      or exists(select 1 from public.operation_failure_events f where f.operation_name='claim_listing'
        and f.details->>'rollback_confirmed'='true' and f.details->>'software_version'='geolock-claim-audit-v1'
        and f.actor_user_id=v_user and (f.listing_id=p_entity_id or f.donation_id=p_entity_id

      then f.details->>'correlation_id' else null end,

    'resulting_state',f.details->>'resulting_state','reason_code',f.reason_code,'outcome','ERROR',

    'software_version',f.details->>'software_version','configuration_version',f.details->>'configuration_version',
    'occurred_at',f.occurred_at))).*
  from public.operation_failure_events f where f.operation_name='claim_listing'
   and f.details->>'rollback_confirmed'='true' and f.details->>'software_version'='geolock-claim-audit-v1'
   and (f.listing_id=p_entity_id or f.donation_id=p_entity_id or f.claim_id=p_entity_id
     or f.details->'donation_ids' @> jsonb_build_array(p_entity_id))
   and (v_role<>'NGO' or f.actor_user_id=v_user)
  ) events order by events.occurred_at,events.event_id;
end;

DECLARE v jsonb; ngo uuid:=auth.uid(); next_id uuid; ok boolean:=false; blocked text; stops jsonb; mixed_ready boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 v:=public.get_my_authorized_route_pre_deferral(p_route);
 IF v->>'ngo_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ngo::text OR v->>'route_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_route::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNED_MANAGED_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
 SELECT x.task_id INTO next_id FROM routing_private.items x JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id)
 WHERE x.route_id=p_route AND x.collected_at IS NULL AND x.released_at IS NULL
  AND t.task_status<>'DISPATCHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=x.route_id AND d.task_id=x.task_id AND d.status='DEFERRED')
 ORDER BY x.ordinal LIMIT 1;
 IF next_id IS NOT NULL AND v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb THEN
  BEGIN PERFORM routing_private.check_remaining(p_route,next_id,clock_timestamp()); ok:=true;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN blocked:=SQLERRM; ok:=false; END;
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(
   s.value || jsonb_build_object(
    'needs_reconciliation',CASE WHEN d.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.status='DEFERRED' ELSE c.claim_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' OR le.lease_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' END,
    'lease_expired_pending_recovery',d.task_id IS NULL AND c.claim_status='ACTIVE' AND le.lease_status='ACTIVE' AND le.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc WHERE rc.claim_id=t.claim_id AND rc.case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')),
    'deferred_for_reconciliation',COALESCE(d.status='DEFERRED',false),
    'deferred_status',d.status,
    'deferred_request_id',d.request_id,
    'can_defer',v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb AND d.task_id IS NULL AND t.task_status IN('PLANNED','CONFIRMED') AND i.consumed_at IS NULL AND i.collected_at IS NULL AND c.claim_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' AND le.lease_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc WHERE rc.claim_id=t.claim_id AND rc.case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')) AND (SELECT route_status FROM public.pickup_routes WHERE route_id=p_route) IN('AUTHORISED','IN_PROGRESS')  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.cases rc WHERE rc.route_id=p_route AND rc.status IN('AWAITING_EVIDENCE','MANUAL_REVIEW')),
    'can_start',v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb AND ok AND s.value->>'task_id'=next_id::text AND i.consumed_at IS NULL AND t.task_status IN('PLANNED','CONFIRMED'),
    'can_complete',s.value->>'can_complete'='true'
   ) ORDER BY (s.value->>'stop_order')::integer),'[]') INTO stops
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'stops') s(value)
 JOIN public.pickup_tasks t ON t.task_id=(s.value->>'task_id')::uuid
 JOIN routing_private.items i ON i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.route_id=p_route
 JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.claim_id=t.claim_id JOIN public.claim_leases le ON le.claim_id=t.claim_id
 LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops d ON d.route_id=p_route AND d.task_id=t.task_id;
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED')
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items i JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id) JOIN public.donation_claims c USING(claim_id) JOIN public.claim_leases le USING(claim_id)
   LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops d ON d.route_id=i.route_id AND d.task_id=i.task_id WHERE i.route_id=p_route

DECLARE v jsonb; ngo uuid:=auth.uid(); next_id uuid; ok boolean:=false; blocked text; stops jsonb; mixed_ready boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 v:=public.get_my_authorized_route_pre_deferral(p_route);
 IF v->>'ngo_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ngo::text OR v->>'route_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_route::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNED_MANAGED_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
 SELECT x.task_id INTO next_id FROM routing_private.items x JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id)
 WHERE x.route_id=p_route AND x.collected_at IS NULL AND x.released_at IS NULL
  AND t.task_status<>'DISPATCHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=x.route_id AND d.task_id=x.task_id AND d.status='DEFERRED')
 ORDER BY x.ordinal LIMIT 1;
 IF next_id IS NOT NULL AND v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb THEN
  BEGIN PERFORM routing_private.check_remaining(p_route,next_id,clock_timestamp()); ok:=true;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN blocked:=SQLERRM; ok:=false; END;
 END IF;

   s.value || jsonb_build_object(
    'needs_reconciliation',CASE WHEN d.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.status='DEFERRED' ELSE c.claim_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' OR le.lease_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' END,
    'lease_expired_pending_recovery',d.task_id IS NULL AND c.claim_status='ACTIVE' AND le.lease_status='ACTIVE' AND le.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc WHERE rc.claim_id=t.claim_id AND rc.case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')),
    'deferred_for_reconciliation',COALESCE(d.status='DEFERRED',false),
    'deferred_status',d.status,
    'deferred_request_id',d.request_id,
    'can_defer',v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb AND d.task_id IS NULL AND t.task_status IN('PLANNED','CONFIRMED') AND i.consumed_at IS NULL AND i.collected_at IS NULL AND c.claim_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' AND le.lease_status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc WHERE rc.claim_id=t.claim_id AND rc.case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')) AND (SELECT route_status FROM public.pickup_routes WHERE route_id=p_route) IN('AUTHORISED','IN_PROGRESS')  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.cases rc WHERE rc.route_id=p_route AND rc.status IN('AWAITING_EVIDENCE','MANUAL_REVIEW')),
    'can_start',v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb AND ok AND s.value->>'task_id'=next_id::text AND i.consumed_at IS NULL AND t.task_status IN('PLANNED','CONFIRMED'),
    'can_complete',s.value->>'can_complete'='true'
   ) ORDER BY (s.value->>'stop_order')::integer),'[]') INTO stops
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'stops') s(value)
 JOIN public.pickup_tasks t ON t.task_id=(s.value->>'task_id')::uuid
 JOIN routing_private.items i ON i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.route_id=p_route
 JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.claim_id=t.claim_id JOIN public.claim_leases le ON le.claim_id=t.claim_id
 LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops d ON d.route_id=p_route AND d.task_id=t.task_id;
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED')
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items i JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id) JOIN public.donation_claims c USING(claim_id) JOIN public.claim_leases le USING(claim_id)
   LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops d ON d.route_id=i.route_id AND d.task_id=i.task_id WHERE i.route_id=p_route
   AND NOT ((i.collected_at IS NOT NULL AND t.task_status='COLLECTED' AND c.claim_status='COMPLETED' AND le.lease_status='COMPLETED')
    OR (d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED' AND i.released_at IS NOT NULL AND t.task_status='STALE' AND c.claim_status='RELEASED' AND le.lease_status='RELEASED')))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.active_task_route_assignments a JOIN public.pickup_tasks at USING(task_id) JOIN routing_private.items ai USING(route_id,task_id) WHERE a.route_id=p_route AND NOT(at.task_status='COLLECTED' AND ai.collected_at IS NOT NULL))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.cases rc WHERE rc.route_id=p_route AND rc.status IN('AWAITING_EVIDENCE','MANUAL_REVIEW'))
 INTO mixed_ready;
 v:=v||jsonb_build_object('stops',stops,'next_executable_task_id',next_id,'dispatch_block_reason',CASE WHEN ok THEN NULL WHEN blocked IS NOT NULL THEN to_jsonb(blocked) ELSE v->'dispatch_block_reason' END,
  'can_close',(v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb) AND (coalesce((v->>'can_close')::boolean,false) OR mixed_ready),
  'can_cancel',coalesce((v->>'can_cancel')::boolean,false) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route),
  'closure_outcome',CASE WHEN mixed_ready THEN 'ABANDONED' WHEN coalesce((v->>'can_close')::boolean,false) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE NULL END,
  'awaiting_individual_reconciliation',next_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='DEFERRED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items i JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id) WHERE i.route_id=p_route AND i.released_at IS NULL AND i.collected_at IS NULL AND t.task_status<>'DISPATCHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=i.route_id AND d.task_id=i.task_id AND d.status='DEFERRED')),
  'has_resolved_uncollected',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED'));
 RETURN v;
END $function$

DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.donations d JOIN public.user_profiles u ON u.user_id=d.donor_user_id
  JOIN public.donor_profiles dp ON dp.user_id=d.donor_user_id
  WHERE d.donation_id=p_donation AND d.donor_user_id=actor AND u.role='DONOR')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='DONATION_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;

 WITH history AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.claim_id,c.ngo_user_id,c.claim_status,l.listing_id,l.listing_status,l.source_type,
   d.donation_id,d.title,le.lease_status,le.expires_at,t.task_id,t.task_status,
   i.route_id,rc.case_id,rc.case_status,rc.opened_at,rc.resolved_at,
   (c.listing_id=l.listing_id AND l.donation_id=p_donation AND l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
    AND d.donor_user_id=actor AND t.claim_id=c.claim_id AND t.listing_id=l.listing_id
    AND le.claim_id=c.claim_id AND (rc.case_id IS NULL OR
     (rc.claim_id=c.claim_id AND rc.listing_id=l.listing_id AND rc.donation_id=p_donation AND rc.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'))) IS TRUE AS binding_valid
  FROM public.donations d
  JOIN public.listings l ON l.donation_id=d.donation_id AND l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
  JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.listing_id=l.listing_id
  JOIN public.pickup_tasks t ON t.claim_id=c.claim_id
  LEFT JOIN public.claim_leases le ON le.claim_id=c.claim_id
  LEFT JOIN routing_private.items i ON i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.released_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc ON rc.claim_id=c.claim_id
  WHERE d.donation_id=p_donation AND d.donor_user_id=actor
 ), scoped AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')) AS open_count,
   coalesce(bool_and(binding_valid),true) AS all_valid FROM history
 ), decorated AS (
  SELECT h.*,de.handover_confirmed AS donor_handover,de.submitted_at AS donor_submitted_at,
   de.response AS donor_response,ne.handover_confirmed AS ngo_handover,ne.submitted_at AS ngo_submitted_at,
   ne.response AS ngo_response,
   CASE
    WHEN s.total>20 THEN 'HISTORY_TRUNCATED'
    WHEN NOT s.all_valid THEN 'ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT'
    WHEN s.open_count>1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_OPEN_CLAIM_CASES'
    WHEN case_status IN('RESOLVED_COLLECTED','RESOLVED_RELEASED') THEN 'RESOLVED_READ_ONLY'
    WHEN case_id IS NULL AND claim_status='ACTIVE' AND lease_status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN 'WAITING_FOR_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
    WHEN case_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_OPEN_RECONCILIATION'
    WHEN case_status<>'OPEN' THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW_OR_TERMINAL'
    WHEN claim_status<>'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' OR lease_status<>'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
     OR listing_status<>'CLAIMED' OR task_status NOT IN('CONFIRMED','PLANNED','DISPATCHED','COLLECTED') THEN 'PICKUP_STATE_REQUIRES_REVIEW'
    WHEN de.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DONOR_EVIDENCE_ALREADY_RECORDED'
    ELSE NULL END AS blocker
  FROM history h CROSS JOIN scoped s

  SELECT c.claim_id,c.ngo_user_id,c.claim_status,l.listing_id,l.listing_status,l.source_type,
   d.donation_id,d.title,le.lease_status,le.expires_at,t.task_id,t.task_status,

    AND d.donor_user_id=actor AND t.claim_id=c.claim_id AND t.listing_id=l.listing_id

     (rc.claim_id=c.claim_id AND rc.listing_id=l.listing_id AND rc.donation_id=p_donation AND rc.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'))) IS TRUE AS binding_valid
  FROM public.donations d
  JOIN public.listings l ON l.donation_id=d.donation_id AND l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
  JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.listing_id=l.listing_id

 ), scoped AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')) AS open_count,
   coalesce(bool_and(binding_valid),true) AS all_valid FROM history

  SELECT h.*,de.handover_confirmed AS donor_handover,de.submitted_at AS donor_submitted_at,
   de.response AS donor_response,ne.handover_confirmed AS ngo_handover,ne.submitted_at AS ngo_submitted_at,

     OR listing_status<>'CLAIMED' OR task_status NOT IN('CONFIRMED','PLANNED','DISPATCHED','COLLECTED') THEN 'PICKUP_STATE_REQUIRES_REVIEW'

  FROM history h CROSS JOIN scoped s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.request_id,e.handover_confirmed,e.submitted_at,e.response FROM routing_private.coord_current_evidence e
   WHERE e.case_id=h.case_id AND e.actor_user_id=actor ORDER BY e.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1) de ON true

 )

  'title',(SELECT title FROM public.donations WHERE donation_id=p_donation),'server_now',statement_timestamp(),

   'donation_id',x.donation_id,'claim_id',x.claim_id,'listing_id',x.listing_id,'task_id',x.task_id,'route_id',x.route_id,
   'case_id',x.case_id,'case_status',x.case_status,'opened_at',x.opened_at,'resolved_at',x.resolved_at,
   'claim_status',x.claim_status,'lease_status',x.lease_status,'lease_expires_at',x.expires_at,
   'task_status',x.task_status,'source_type',x.source_type,'can_submit_evidence',x.blocker IS NULL,

   'donor_evidence',jsonb_build_object('handover_confirmed',x.donor_handover,'submitted_at',x.donor_submitted_at,'response',x.donor_response),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_reconciliation_cases()
 RETURNS TABLE(case_id uuid, claim_id uuid, listing_id uuid, donation_id uuid, source_type text, case_status text, opened_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_user uuid:=auth.uid(); v_role text;
begin
  if v_user is null then raise exception 'UNAUTHENTICATED'; end if;
  select p.role into v_role from public.user_profiles p where p.user_id=v_user;
  if v_role not in ('DONOR','NGO','HUB_ADMIN') then raise exception 'ROLE_REQUIRED'; end if;
  return query
  select rc.case_id,rc.claim_id,rc.listing_id,rc.donation_id,rc.source_type,rc.case_status,rc.opened_at
  from public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc
  join public.donation_claims c using(claim_id)
  join public.listings l using(listing_id)
  where rc.case_status in ('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW') and (
    (v_role='NGO' and c.ngo_user_id=v_user)
    or (v_role='DONOR' and l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' and exists(
      select 1 from public.donations d where d.donation_id=l.donation_id and d.donor_user_id=v_user))
    or (v_role='HUB_ADMIN' and l.source_type='HUB_BATCH' and exists(
      select 1 from public.hub_batches b join public.community_hubs h using(hub_id)
      where b.batch_id=l.batch_id and h.admin_user_id=v_user))
  ) order by rc.opened_at desc,rc.case_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.install_routing_policy(p_request uuid, p_body jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '0'
AS $function$
DECLARE id uuid; old jsonb; BEGIN
 PERFORM routing_private.worker('geolock_graph_worker');
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('routing-policy:'||p_request::text,0));
 SELECT policy_id,body INTO id,old FROM routing_private.policies WHERE request_id=p_request;
 IF FOUND THEN IF old IS DISTINCT FROM p_body THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_CONFLICT'; END IF; RETURN id; END IF;
 IF p_request IS NULL OR p_body IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_body->'mandatory') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
 OR NOT(p_body?'horizon_minutes' AND p_body?'dispatch_margin_minutes' AND p_body?'direct_service_minutes' AND p_body?'hub_service_minutes')
 OR NOT coalesce(((p_body->>'horizon_minutes')::numeric>0 AND (p_body->>'horizon_minutes')::numeric<=1440
 AND (p_body->>'dispatch_margin_minutes')::numeric>=0 AND (p_body->>'direct_service_minutes')::numeric>=0
 AND (p_body->>'hub_service_minutes')::numeric>=0 AND (p_body->>'horizon_minutes')::numeric<'Infinity'::numeric
 AND (p_body->>'dispatch_margin_minutes')::numeric<'Infinity'::numeric AND (p_body->>'direct_service_minutes')::numeric<'Infinity'::numeric
 AND (p_body->>'hub_service_minutes')::numeric<'Infinity'::numeric),false)
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_body->'solver') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_body->'execution') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXPLICIT_ROUTING_POLICY_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO routing_private.policies(request_id,body,digest) VALUES(p_request,p_body,routing_private.hash(p_body)) RETURNING policy_id INTO id;
 RETURN id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_route_test_provenance(p_run uuid, p_manifest text, p_ngo uuid, p_vehicle uuid, p_claims uuid[], p_request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor text:=resolution_private.operator_key(); payload jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('run',p_run,'manifest',p_manifest,'ngo',p_ngo,'vehicle',p_vehicle,'claims',p_claims); prior jsonb; BEGIN
 PERFORM resolution_private.require_enabled(); prior:=resolution_private.receipt(actor,p_request,'TEST_PROVENANCE',payload); IF prior IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN prior; END IF;
 IF p_run IS NULL OR p_manifest IS NULL OR p_manifest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR cardinality(p_claims) IS NULL OR cardinality(p_claims)=0
 OR cardinality(p_claims)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM unnest(p_claims) x) OR array_position(p_claims,NULL) IS NOT NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.vehicles WHERE vehicle_id=p_vehicle AND ngo_user_id=p_ngo)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p_claims) x LEFT JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.claim_id=x WHERE c.claim_id IS NULL OR c.ngo_user_id<>p_ngo)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.test_runs WHERE fixture_claim_ids && p_claims) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TEST_PROVENANCE_SCOPE'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO resolution_private.test_runs VALUES(p_run,'rcgyuwiidqvrgbxswhqj',p_manifest,p_ngo,p_vehicle,p_claims,clock_timestamp());
 RETURN resolution_private.save_receipt(actor,p_request,'TEST_PROVENANCE',payload,jsonb_build_object('run_id',p_run,'outcome','REGISTERED'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolution_private.operator_key()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 -- Native operators never inherit an authenticated participant's JWT context.
 -- Inspect raw settings first: even malformed JSON/UUIDs must fail before replay.
 IF coalesce(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub',true),'')<>''
 OR coalesce(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')<>''
 OR coalesce(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role',true),'')<>'' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESOLVER_JWT_CONTEXT_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_has_role(session_user,'geolock_route_resolver','MEMBER') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.operators WHERE login_name=session_user AND active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESTRICTED_RESOLVER_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 RETURN 'resolver:'||session_user;
END $function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE x record; v jsonb; BEGIN
 SELECT t.claim_id,t.task_status,c.claim_status,c.close_reason,c.closed_at,c.ngo_user_id,le.lease_id,le.lease_status,le.release_reason,le.expires_at,le.closed_at lease_closed_at,
 i.released_at,i.collected_at,ds.status deferred_status,ds.claim_id deferred_claim,ds.ngo_id,b.ngo_id owner_id
 INTO x FROM routing_private.items i JOIN routing_private.bindings b USING(route_id) LEFT JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id)
 LEFT JOIN public.donation_claims c USING(claim_id) LEFT JOIN public.claim_leases le USING(claim_id)
 LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops ds USING(route_id,task_id) WHERE i.route_id=p_route AND i.task_id=p_task;
 IF NOT FOUND OR x.claim_id IS NULL OR x.lease_id IS NULL OR x.task_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'STALE' OR x.claim_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'RELEASED'
 OR x.lease_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'RELEASED' OR x.released_at IS NULL OR x.collected_at IS NOT NULL OR x.closed_at IS NULL OR x.lease_closed_at IS NULL
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.active_task_route_assignments WHERE task_id=p_task) OR x.ngo_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM x.owner_id OR x.deferred_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED' OR x.deferred_claim IS DISTINCT FROM x.claim_id OR x.ngo_id IS DISTINCT FROM x.owner_id
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases WHERE claim_id=x.claim_id AND case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_events WHERE claim_id=x.claim_id AND outcome='SUCCESS' AND (event_type='COMPLETE_PICKUP' OR resulting_state IN('COLLECTED','COMPLETED'))) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF x.close_reason='EXPIRED_SAFE_RELEASE' AND x.release_reason=x.close_reason THEN
  RETURN x.expires_at<=x.lease_closed_at AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases WHERE claim_id=x.claim_id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_events WHERE claim_id=x.claim_id AND lease_id=x.lease_id AND event_type='LEASE_RECOVERY' AND reason_code='EXPIRED_SAFE_RELEASE' AND resulting_state='RELEASED' AND outcome='SUCCESS');
 END IF;
 v:=routing_private.coord_votes(x.claim_id);
 RETURN x.close_reason IN('RECONCILED_NO_HANDOVER','RECONCILED_STARTED_NO_HANDOVER') AND x.release_reason=x.close_reason
  AND v->>'count'='2' AND v->>'valid'='2' AND v->>'yes'='0'
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.claim_reconciliation_cases WHERE claim_id=x.claim_id AND case_status='RESOLVED_RELEASED' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolution_reason='BOTH_PARTIES_CONFIRMED_NO_HANDOVER');
END $function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION routing_private.release_expired_unstarted_stop(p_claim uuid, p_task uuid, p_ngo uuid, p_route uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '0'
AS $function$
DECLARE i routing_private.items%rowtype; r public.pickup_routes%rowtype;
        next_id uuid; req uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO i FROM routing_private.items
 WHERE route_id=p_route AND task_id=p_task AND released_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR i.consumed_at IS NOT NULL OR i.collected_at IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.pickup_routes WHERE route_id=p_route;
 IF NOT FOUND OR r.route_status NOT IN('AUTHORISED','IN_PROGRESS') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.cases c
   WHERE c.route_id=p_route AND c.status IN('AWAITING_EVIDENCE','MANUAL_REVIEW')) THEN
  RETURN false; -- retain the legacy whole-route hold until authorized resolution
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d
   WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.task_id=p_task) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT x.task_id INTO next_id FROM routing_private.items x
 JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id)
 WHERE x.route_id=p_route AND x.released_at IS NULL AND x.collected_at IS NULL
  AND x.task_id<>p_task
  AND t.task_status<>'DISPATCHED'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d
    WHERE d.route_id=x.route_id AND d.task_id=x.task_id AND d.status='DEFERRED')
 ORDER BY x.ordinal LIMIT 1;
 IF next_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items x
   JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id)
   WHERE x.route_id=p_route AND x.task_id<>p_task
     AND x.released_at IS NULL AND t.task_status='DISPATCHED'
 ) OR EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items x
   JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id)
   JOIN public.donation_claims c USING(claim_id)
   JOIN public.claim_leases le USING(claim_id)
   WHERE x.route_id=p_route AND x.task_id<>p_task
     AND x.released_at IS NULL AND x.consumed_at IS NULL AND x.collected_at IS NULL
     AND t.task_status='PLANNED' AND c.claim_status='ACTIVE'
     AND le.lease_status='ACTIVE' AND le.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
 ) THEN
  -- A different in-progress pickup makes check_remaining report
  -- PREVIOUS_PICKUP_UNRESOLVED; another expired, unstarted active stop also
  -- makes route feasibility fail on its lease. Neither is evidence that this
  -- PLANNED target was collected. Detach this claim independently; route start
  -- will revalidate feasibility after other dispatches finish; recovery
  -- handles each other expired stop, and check_remaining will revalidate
  -- the resulting route before any later pickup starts.
  INSERT INTO routing_private.deferred_stops(route_id,task_id,claim_id,ngo_id,request_id,reason)
  VALUES(p_route,p_task,p_claim,p_ngo,req,'LEASE_EXPIRED');
 ELSE
  -- Catch only the route-feasibility rejection. P0001 raised by the deferral
  -- insert, guards, or any later statement must abort rather than be treated
  -- as an ordinary infeasible route. The insert is inside this subtransaction
  -- so an expected feasibility rejection leaves no partial deferred-stop row.
  BEGIN
   INSERT INTO routing_private.deferred_stops(route_id,task_id,claim_id,ngo_id,request_id,reason)
   VALUES(p_route,p_task,p_claim,p_ngo,req,'LEASE_EXPIRED');
   PERFORM routing_private.check_remaining(p_route,next_id,clock_timestamp());
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE 'P0001' THEN
   IF SQLERRM NOT IN (
     'ROUTE_BINDING_DRIFT','DISPATCH_AUTHORITY_STALE',
     'WHOLE_ROUTE_INTERRUPTION_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION',
     'BEFORE_AUTHORIZED_DEPARTURE','PREVIOUS_PICKUP_UNRESOLVED',
     'STOP_ORDER_REQUIRED','DISPATCH_SOURCE_STALE',
     'DISPATCH_WINDOW_OR_LEASE_EXPIRED','REMAINING_ROUTE_INFEASIBLE'
   ) THEN RAISE; END IF;
   RETURN false;
  END;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO routing_private.deferred_release_permits(task_id,transaction_id)
 VALUES(p_task,pg_current_xact_id()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE'; END IF;

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION routing_private.task_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '0'
AS $function$
DECLARE i routing_private.items%rowtype; BEGIN
 IF NEW.task_status=OLD.task_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO i FROM routing_private.items WHERE task_id=OLD.task_id AND (released_at IS NULL OR release_xid=pg_current_xact_id()) ORDER BY released_at NULLS FIRST,ordinal LIMIT 1;
 IF NEW.task_status='DISPATCHED' THEN
  IF i.dispatch_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR i.consumed_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATABASE_DISPATCH_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 ELSIF NEW.task_status='COLLECTED' THEN
  IF i.complete_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.legacy_inflight WHERE task_id=OLD.task_id AND complete_xid=pg_current_xact_id())
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROTECTED_COMPLETION_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 ELSIF i.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF NOT ((OLD.task_status='CONFIRMED' AND NEW.task_status='PLANNED' AND i.planned_xid=pg_current_xact_id())
    OR (OLD.task_status='PLANNED' AND NEW.task_status='CONFIRMED' AND i.release_xid=pg_current_xact_id())
    OR (NEW.task_status='STALE' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.permits p WHERE p.task_id=OLD.task_id AND p.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_release_permits p WHERE p.task_id=OLD.task_id AND p.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()))))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESERVED_TASK_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
